item.title: Liquid D&B Mix by DJ Lipmaster Mark (Rat Pack)
item.itunes:title: Liquid D&B Mix by DJ Lipmaster Mark (Rat Pack)
item.description:
So what if I don't play D&B out in clubs (well, not all the time) it doesn't mean I don't like it!
Here's a mix I done early 2011, and after getting a good reaction on it, and as I said before, who better to share it with than you guys. So here it is, I hope you enjoy.
Once again, thank you for your support...The donation button is on this page somewhere =8-) (it pays for bandwith, which podomatic charge me for...the more bandwith, the more people can download. All donations welcome.)
DJ Lipmaster Mark (Rat Pack)
www.facebook.com/ratpackuk www.twitter.com/ratpackuk www.ratpackmusic.net

item.title: OldSkool Mix by DJ Lipmaster Mark (Rat Pack)
item.itunes:title: OldSkool Mix by DJ Lipmaster Mark (Rat Pack)
item.description:
Hi Everyone, =8-)
Sorry for the delay since the last podcast. I've been really busy and it seems like it's taken FOREVER to get back on here. Thank you to EVERYONE who has downloaded the last podcasts. You put me in the No.1 spot in the charts on here, and that is something that made me soooo happy, and is right up there in my personal list. So once again THANK YOU!!
Here's a little mix I done for our (Rat Pack) guest appearance on Billy Daniel Bunter's 'Music Mondays' on Kool London (http://www.koollondon.com/) alongside the one and only DJ Slipmatt. And who better to share it with than YOU! I hope to be putting the whole radio show, which has some excellent Oldskool tunes on it, thanks to Slipmatt and Bunter who done some deep crate diggin' and it also includes part of this mix.
I hope you enjoy. DJ Lipmaster Mark (Rat Pack) =8-)
www.ratpackmusic.net www.facebook.com/ratpackuk www.twitter.com/ratpackuk
Track List:
1.2 Bad Mice - 2 Bad Mice 2.X-Tremity E.P. B2 3.The Housecrew - Get On Up 4.2 Bad Mice - Bombscare Remix 5.DJ Rap - Devine Rhythm 6.The Housecrew - We Are Hardcore (Magic Fantasy Mix) 7.DJ Seduction - Come On 8.X-Ray Experiments - Take No Chance 9.DJ Tango - Can't Stop The Rush Remix 10.Oaysis - Incredible Bass (Remix) 11.Family Foundation - Xpress Yourself 12.Bodysnatch - Euphony (Just For U London) 13.DJ Lipmaster Mark - After Thought

item.title: Rat Pack at The Moondance Camden Palace Reunion
item.itunes:title: Rat Pack at The Moondance Camden Palace Reunion
item.description:
Rat Pack Set From The Camden Palace Reunion at Koko London 21st August 2011. DJ Lipmaster Mark & MC Evenson Allen.
Big Love To Everyone Who Made It There. If You Didn't, Here's Your Chance To Hear Our Set. Big Up To Funky, Will, Gordy and All The Crew...We Can't Wait For The Next One.
For More info on Moondance, visit, www.ehmproductions.com Also Check Out Our Page On Facebook www.facebook.com/ratpackuk And Also www.ratpackmusic.net
Check Out The Rest Of The Mixes In "The Rat Pack Mix Episodes" And Leave A Comment Too.
Hope You Enjoy.
DJ Lipmaster Mark. =8-) X

item.title: Progressive/Electro/Tech Mix Up by DJ Lipmaster Mark (Rat Pack)
item.itunes:title: Progressive/Electro/Tech Mix Up by DJ Lipmaster Mark (Rat Pack)
item.description:
Welcome back to The Rat Pack Mix Episodes. Bringing to you a mixture of styles and banging beats that are guaranteed to make you get your party wiggle out!
Due to popular demand (Thank you, thank you, so much too) it seems that the bandwith is running out too quickly and some of you are missing out on downloads. If everyone who has subscribed made just a 20p or 20c donation via the "Donation" Tab on the www.podomatic.ratpack.com page it would pay for even more bandwith. It all helps, no matter how little. I hope you enjoy the mix. =8-)
www.ratpackmusic.net www.facebook.com/ratpackuk
Track List: 01. Mory Kante vs Loverush UK! - Yeke Yeke 2011 (Ronski Speed Remix) - Loverush Digital 02. Danny Freakazoid Strobe-Circus of Love-Big Dirty Recordings 03. Tate Diamond-Turn It Back (Original Club Dub)-Azuli 04. Yacek-Complicated Policies-Bugeyed Records 05. Answer42-Dew Point-Original Mix-AnjunaDeep 06. Funkerman-Fallin In Love (Original Mix)(feat.
